g.text: One loop, ending at a human
failed: triage note on the MR
fact matched? class, retry_safe, first failing line; one retry only when transient and safe
never a shell timeout, never a hand poll
commit: named paths only, subject in the repo's style, no trailers unless asked
ship-mr: push, open or re-sync the MR from the plan, name sibling MRs touching the same files
watch-pipeline: bounded wait → triage against facts → one safe retry → 'ready' or a reason; never merges
after-merge: fast-forward, prune, linked issues closed?, sibling hunks survived?, watch main
